text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While watching over the training track,
Agnes Digital was also closely observing the course.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uhyooo~!! Horse Girls running alongside each other!!
The sight of communicating with gazes alone without saying a single word!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "Thanks to you, I'm surpassing my own limits."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "Chase after me and catch up! You can do it!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And the one chasing after is both friend and rival!
Mu-hyooo~! The overflowing passion...!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bravo!
I heard that passionate étude of yours!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
HYOEEE?! O-Opera O-san?!
Wh-wh-why are you here?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Stupid Digi-tan, failing to blend into the background like a wall!!
On top of that, having my delusions overheard by my oshi?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nay, that is a truly magnificent talent for improvisation!
Digital-kun, won't you take the stage together with me?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And then, we shall sing an opera at the top of our lungs,
proclaiming my grand achievements as the Overlord to the entire world!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: That girl's getting caught up by Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I heard someone from the next class was forced
to sit through her original opera for 8 hours straight...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a moment. I, too, have business with Digital-kun.
As an indispensable... subject of observation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-No way?! Tachyon-san too?!
And saying something so ominous to boot~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I am currently observing the mechanism
by which she converts her interest in other Horse Girls into raw power.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Goodness...!?
She's even gotten Tachyon-san wrapped up in this!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I heard a girl from the class next door was forced
to participate in one of Tachyon-san's terrifying experiments...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why do you hesitate, Digital-kun?!
Come, take my hand!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The lab is all prepared.
I'd like to test my various hypotheses without delay.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What do I do...?
How do I handle this situation...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both proposals sound like sheer punishment games.
It's only natural that Agnes Digital is in distress.
choice_data_list: If you don't want to, you should turn them down...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? "Don't want to"?! Not in a million years!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Sharing the stage with Opera O-san...!
Being Tachyon-san's test subject...!!
Those are nothing short of the ultimate rewards!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm not sure if I have what it takes
to pull off such a monumental task...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Can Digi-tan truly live up to the expectations of her faves?!
...No matter how much research I do, I'm filled with nothing but anxiety!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Both Opera O-san and Tachyon-san
have their own unshakable, magnificent worlds...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I think Agnes Digital certainly has a strong world of her own as well,
but she seems to lack confidence.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, no, absolutely not! I'm just a mere otaku...
I am not worthy of standing alongside my faves!
choice_data_list: But it's a request from your faves, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's true...!
What came over me?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Bluntly refusing a request from my beloved faves
would be utterly insolent! Deserving of ten thousand deaths!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
As an otaku, that is unthinkable!
In other words, the only right answer here is to accept both!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As expected of one chosen by me!
You have quite a magnificent, generous spirit!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, so I shall observe the two of you
performing an opera together... How fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Dyehuhu, if my wild delusions can be of use to my faves,
it goes way beyond embarrassment into pure honor!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Agnes Digital spent a lengthy amount of time
accompanying them for both the opera performance and the observation...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! The depth of my devotion to my faves
is being tested... right here, right now, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Troubling my faves just because I'm waffling around
is completely outrageous! Truly unprecedented!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Having the full schedules of your fave horse girls
memorized by heart is basic otaku common sense!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, if we're doing this, let's go for a grand stage!
We can reserve the stage this weekend!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, indeed!
Thinking of the audience, that is magnificent!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! Not only do you possess a talent for drama,
what extraordinary management capabilities you have!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san, since we're roommates,
could you conduct the observation at the Ritto Dormitory?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see. You observe the horse girls in Ritto Dormitory,
and I observe you... A rather rational plan.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that the subject being observed was me all along?
Fufufu... increasingly fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, through a magnificent opera and observation results,
Digi-tan shall dedicate her all to you!
